newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Intercontinental 1996 profit rises 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Irish Intercontinental 1996 profit rises 14 pct.

text.p: Irish Intercontinental Bank said on Thursday that profits after tax, minority interests and preference dividends, rose by 14 percent to 18 million Irish pounds last year, giving a return on equity of 24 percent.

The bank, which is 75-percent owned by Belgium's Kredietbank NV and 25-percent by Irish Life Assurance Plc, said it had consolidated and grown its strong position in the corporate and home loans market in Ireland and in Britain during the year.

"It remains our objective to develop our core corporate banking business in Ireland and to work in joint venture with both shareholders in those retail and international financial markets that offer perceived opportunities," chairman Paddy McEvoy said in a statement.
The bank said its operations in Dublin's International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) and its retail financing joint venture grew substantially last year.
The IFSC operation, KB Financial Services (Ireland), has been designated as the global centre for all aerospace, project and shipping finance for Kredietbank.
It recently opened an office in Hong Kong which will focus on developing the Asian and Pacific rim markets and will shortly open another office in the U.S., Irish Intercontinental said.
Irish Life Finance Group, the joint retail venture established with Irish Life Assurance, had its best year ever and made a substantial contribution to the bank's profits.

It specialises in the provision of loans for residential property as well as the financing of commercial property, motor vehicles, machinery and other assets and achieved record levels of new business in all its main product areas.
Irish Intercontinental said residential home loans were particularly strong with advances in this area of 140 million Irish pounds.
The company has over seven percent of the annual residential mortgage market in Ireland.
The bank's British subsidiary, Kredietfinance Corporation, which specialises in medium-sized asset finance and commercial mortgages, continued the steady growth of previous years.
